description: Historical balances of any 0x address on Base: ETH and the main tokens (USDC, WETH, cbBTC, DAI, USDbC, cbETH, AERO, EURC, plus up to 5 more) read at one block per day for up to 30 days, with ETH priced from the on-chain Uniswap pool at each date and the USD value change. Use to see how a wallet's holdings moved, check a balance on a past date, or chart a treasury. Example: address=0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

address.description: 0x wallet or contract address on Base

days.description: How many days back, one point per day (1-30, default 7)

tokens.description: Optional extra token addresses on Base, comma-separated (up to 5)

name: wallet_balance_history
title: Historical balances, wallet history
